name: Rat Royale

features.name: Rat king wilds
features.description: Centre-reel wilds with multipliers up to 500x that also trigger one of four spin modifiers.

features.name: Wild multipliers
features.description: Standard wilds land with values up to 100x, and all multipliers in a win are added together.

features.name: Three bonus versions
features.description: 3, 4 or 5 scatters choose between free spins with richer wilds, a sticky progressive rat king, or an expanded one.

review:
A dark gothic game where everything runs through multiplier wilds. Regular wilds land with up to 100x, while rat king wilds on the centre reel go up to 500x, and multipliers in a win add together.

Each rat king also fires one of four modifiers – expanding over its reel, collecting or boosting other wilds, or turning blue symbols into wild multipliers. Three to five scatters start one of three 10-spin bonus versions. 96.52% RTP. For multiplier hunters.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
